:CUSTOM_MAP_LOAD_CUSTOM_CAR_NODES

//в пизду!!1, пускай грузятся при каждом сейве-загрузке-новой игре мне пох!!!

//0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_TOTAL_COUNT offset
//0A8D: TEMPVAR_INT2 = read_memory TEMPVAR_INT size 4 virtual_protect 0
//if or
//TEMPVAR_INT2 > 3000
//TEMPVAR_INT2 < -1
//then
//TEMPVAR_INT2 = 0 //пути не загружены, в памяти мусор
//end

//0AD1: show_formatted_text_highpriority "CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_TOTAL_COUNT is %d" time 5000 TEMPVAR_INT2
//if
//TEMPVAR_INT2 > 0 //пути загружены в память, снова не грузим //CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0     
//then
//return
//end

if
0AAB:   file_exists "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini"
    then
    
    ///////////////////////////LOADING TEXT///////////////////////////
    03F0: enable_text_draw 1  
    0349: set_text_draw_font 2
    0342: set_text_draw_centered 0
    
    if
    DIRECTFONT_INSTALLED == 1
    then    
    0340: set_text_draw_RGBA DIRECTFONT_FONT2_R DIRECTFONT_FONT2_G DIRECTFONT_FONT2_B 255
    else
    0340: set_text_draw_RGBA 180 180 180 255
    end
     
    033F: set_text_draw_letter_size 0.5 1.25
    033E: set_draw_text_position 290.0 190.0 GXT 'GAME53'  // Push 
    ///////////////////////////LOADING TEXT///////////////////////////
    
    0AC6: 12@ = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset        
    ///////////////////////////////////////////
    
    for CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT = 0 to 2999
        
    0AD3: v$EDITOR_FILE = format "ND%d" CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT                
    if    
    0AF2: 31@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "X"
        then
        
        if
        not CARMA_END_MUS_FLAG == 69
        then
        0AF2: 1@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "X"
        0AF2: 2@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "Y"
        0AF2: 3@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "Z"
        0AF2: 4@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "A"
        //нахуй дважды, еблан? пиши сразу//
        008B: 31@ = CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT // (int)
        31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
        0EE3: write_struct_offset_multi 12@ offset 31@ count 4 size 4 1@ 2@ 3@ 4@
//        018A: 13@ = create_checkpoint_at 1@ 2@ 3@          
//        marker.SetIconSize(13@,1)
        //нахуй дважды, еблан? пишем сразу//
        end
            
        else
        10@ -= 1
        break
        end
        
    end
    
    CARMA_END_MUS_FLAG = 69
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_TOTAL_COUNT offset
    0A8C: write_memory TEMPVAR_INT2 size 4 value CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT virtual_protect 0
    
//    0AD1: show_formatted_text_highpriority "custom_nodes.ini OPENED, total nodes count %d" time 1000 CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT
//    wait 1000
    
    ////////////////////////////////////////////    
        
//    0AC6: 12@ = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset
//        
//    for 9@ = 0 to CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT
//    0AD3: v$EDITOR_FILE = format "ND%d" 9@   
//    0AF2: 1@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "X"
//    0AF2: 2@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "Y"
//    0AF2: 3@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "Z"
//    0AF2: 4@ = get_float_from_ini_file "modloader\ZA CUSTOM MAP FOLDER\custom_nodes.ini" section v$EDITOR_FILE key "A"   
//    0085: 31@ = 9@
//    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
//    0EE3: write_struct_offset_multi 12@ offset 31@ count 4 size 4 1@ 2@ 3@ 4@
//    018A: 13@ = create_checkpoint_at 1@ 2@ 3@          
//    marker.SetIconSize(13@,1)
//    end
        
//    0AD1: show_formatted_text_highpriority "read done, total count %d" time 1000 CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT
//    wait 1000
    end
    
return

:CUSTOM_MAP_TRY_TO_GET_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE

if
CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0
    then     
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset                  
    random_int TEMPVAR_INT 0 CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT    
    008B: 31@ = TEMPVAR_INT // (int)
    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
    0EE2: read_struct_offset_multi TEMPVAR_INT2 offset 31@ count 4 size 4 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT2_1  
    
    if
    0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates PLAYER_ACTOR pos $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 radius 500.0
    then
    if
    0E4D: random_percent 60
        then
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 1
        else
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 0
        end
    end
     
    end

return

:CUSTOM_MAP_TRY_TO_GET_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_100

if
CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0
    then     
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset                  
    random_int TEMPVAR_INT 0 CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT    
    008B: 31@ = TEMPVAR_INT // (int)
    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
    0EE2: read_struct_offset_multi TEMPVAR_INT2 offset 31@ count 4 size 4 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT2_1  
    
    if
    0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates PLAYER_ACTOR pos $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 radius 100.0
    then
    if
    0E4D: random_percent 60
        then
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 1
        else
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 0
        end
    end
     
    end

return

:CUSTOM_MAP_TRY_TO_GET_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FOR_SPAWN

if
CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0
    then     
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset                  
    random_int TEMPVAR_INT 0 CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT    
    008B: 31@ = TEMPVAR_INT // (int)
    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
    0EE2: read_struct_offset_multi TEMPVAR_INT2 offset 31@ count 4 size 4 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT2_1      
    if
    0E4D: random_percent 60
        then
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 1
        else
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 0
        end     
    end

return

:CUSTOM_MAP_RENDER_CUSTOM_CAR_NODES

if
CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0
    then                       

    for TEMPVAR_INT = 0 to CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset
    008B: 31@ = TEMPVAR_INT // (int)
    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
    0EE2: read_struct_offset_multi TEMPVAR_INT2 offset 31@ count 4 size 4 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT2_1           
    if
    0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates PLAYER_ACTOR pos $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 radius 100.0
        then
        0D54: draw_corona_with_extra_params_texture 0 color 0 0 255 255 on_entity 0 at $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 size 1.0 far_clip 2000.0 near_clip 1.5 flare 0 enable_reflection 1 check_obstacles 0 flash_while_fading 0 fade_speed 15.0 only_from_below 0
        end
    end
        
    end

return

:CUSTOM_MAP_CHECK_FOR_ANY_NEAR_CAR_NODE_100

if
CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT > 0
    then                       
    USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 0

    for TEMPVAR_INT = 0 to CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_COUNT
    0AC6: TEMPVAR_INT2 = label @CUSTOM_CAR_NODES offset
    008B: 31@ = TEMPVAR_INT // (int)
    31@ *= 16 //size of xyz
    0EE2: read_struct_offset_multi TEMPVAR_INT2 offset 31@ count 4 size 4 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT2_1           
    if
    0EEA: locate_char_distance_to_coordinates PLAYER_ACTOR pos $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_1 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_2 $TEMPVAR_FLOAT_3 radius 100.0
        then
        USE_CUSTOM_CAR_NODE_FLAG = 1
        end
    end
        
    end

return

:CUSTOM_CAR_NODES_TOTAL_COUNT
hex 
00 00 00 00
end
